decisions.reason: Although later web visibility is unclear, this small-volume chamber is a core dosimetry product and management would be inclined to justify prior certification and launch investment by retaining it unless evidence of failure became unmistakable.

As another specialist chamber close to the firm's established measurement franchise, management would likely continue it, though overlap within the chamber portfolio makes rationalization somewhat more plausible than at launch.
This relative dosimetry chamber supports portfolio completeness and cross-selling into the firm's QA workflow, so sunk costs and strategic fit favor staying the course.

A thimble ionization chamber is a standard, credible anchor product for a German medical-physics supplier, and once kept for several years it is likely to be maintained because it reinforces the installed base and broader service offering.
